name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, attending the Hungarian Grand Prix with his father. He pursued a degree in marketing, focusing his studies on brand development and digital engagement within the sports industry. Before joining Walkenhorst Motorsport, Zoltán honed his skills at a local karting team, where he successfully increased their social media presence and secured several sponsorships. 

At Walkenhorst, Zoltán is responsible for developing and executing marketing campaigns, managing social media channels, and coordinating media relations. He is known for his data-driven approach, constantly analyzing campaign performance to optimize results. Zoltán is also a stickler for detail, ensuring that all marketing materials align with the team's brand identity. His demanding nature pushes the team to always strive for excellence. 

What sets Zoltán apart is his unwavering belief in the power of storytelling. He believes that every team and driver has a unique story to tell, and it is his mission to bring those stories to life for fans around the world.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side part.
physical.description: Zoltán is of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down marketing ideas, even during lunch.
Insists on using a specific type of blue pen for all official documents.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when he's deep in thought.
